liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Listener finds the nine-minute duration sufficient, preferring it to longer, drawn-out versions [22]
- **Dear Mr. Fantasy** (1 review): Listener calls it their best heard, noting a slower tempo creates a gargantuan feel [17]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (1 review): Listener calls it the best revival version, highlighting top-tier playing by Weir, Garcia, and Mydland [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-10-19.fob.sennme80.wklitz.101809.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1989-10-19.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83305.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 161 min; rated 3.64/5 by 11 [4]
- **gd1989-10-19.120498.mk21.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Listener states the MK21 front-of-house recording has better bass and punch than the ME 80 [23]
- **gd1989-10-19.mtx.hansokolow.96967.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Listener drove from Penn State and saw a man trading a brass espresso machine for a ticket [18]
- Brent sings 'goddamned mother gone' during Death Don't Have No Mercy, adding a sinister mood [19]
- Listener recalls no earpieces and no John Cutler mixes, citing a more organic stage presence [20]
- Listener finds this show more energetic than the October 16, 1989 performance [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-10-19.fob.sennme80.wklitz.101809.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1 from 2 rows in front of Soundboard [1]
- **gd1989-10-19.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83305.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [4]. Also: Source is a cassette master from Nakamichi 300/CP4 and 100/CP1 recorders, patched by Steve Cherson [4]
- **gd1989-10-19.120498.mk21.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Craig Hillwig; transferred by Lenny Stubbe; source: Source: Schoeps CMC5/MK21> ? > DAT (probably Schoeps CMC5/MK21> Oade P/S > Panasonic SV250) (48 khz); Location: FOB; [7]
- **gd1989-10-19.mtx.hansokolow.96967.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of SBD: shnid=83305 and DAUD: shnid=7595 [2]
